Palo Capital Inc increased its stake in Western Digital Corp (WDC) by 245.79% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Palo Capital Inc bought 18,948 shares as the company’s stock declined 26.98% with the market. The hedge fund held 26,657 shares of the electronic components company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $1.56M, up from 7,709 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Palo Capital Inc who had been investing in Western Digital Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $11.35B market cap company. The stock increased 7.49% or $2.73 during the last trading session, reaching $39.2. About 9.35M shares traded or 36.21% up from the average.
